item.title: Meaningless Words
item.description:
Meaningless Words Liz Jones

Source: TW

Author: Liz Jones

The following is a poem from the book ‘Simply This’ by Liz Jones. It may be purchased directly from her website, by post (address at website) or from Watkins Bookshop in London.

See the recommendation for this book.

Meaningless Words

Everything is dual.
Nothing is non-dual.
But nothing appears as everything,
So what is dual is really non-dual,
Which means what is dual can’t be dual…
